EventDetail/Send/Data[@Name='subject']/@: The `subject` value recorded in a Data element of Send.
EventSource: Where the event came from, i.e. what generator created the event and on what device.
@StreamId: The id of the Events stream the event came from.
@EventId: The event's number in its stream; with StreamId, it identifies the event.
EventSource/Device/IPAddress: The network IP address of the device, e.g. 192.168.0.3.
EventDetail/Network/*/Source/Device/IPAd: The network IP address of the device, e.g. 192.168.0.3.
EventDetail/Authenticate/Outcome/Success: If the outcome of an event was successful then 'true', 'false' otherwise.
EventDetail/View/Object/Id: An identifier for the object, e.g a document ID in a document management system.
EventSource/Device/@Foo: The `Foo` attribute of Device: A description of the event source that the event generator is hosted upon.
Data[@Name='x']/@Value: The `x` value recorded in a Data element of Data.
EventDetail/Unknown/Data: Any other event data that does not fit into a schema element but may be useful for the purpose of audit.
